editorial:
Imagine you are on a fancy train ride from Venice to Paris, surrounded by luxury and beautiful views. That is where you meet Lily, an American woman who gets a huge shock when she runs into her ex-boyfriend, Alex. They had a sweet romance ten years ago in France, but he vanished without a word, leaving her heartbroken. Now that they are trapped on the Orient Express together, the tension is high. You get to watch them navigate their old feelings while Lily tries to figure out why he really left her all those years ago. It feels like a classic soap opera set on wheels, focusing on lost love and old wounds.

The acting is solid and the scenery makes you feel like you are actually traveling through Europe. The slow pace helps build the mystery of Alex's secret, though some might find it a bit too slow at times. If you love stories about second chances and romantic secrets, you will really enjoy this one. It is a great pick for a cozy movie night with a glass of wine.
endingExplained: At the end, Lily finally discovers the truth about why Alex disappeared. He was dealing with personal struggles and family secrets that he felt would ruin her life. Once everything is out in the open, they realize they still love each other deeply. Instead of letting the past keep them apart, they decide to forgive one another. They choose to start over and stay together as the train reaches its final stop.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old-school romance and emotional reunions.
